draft.emotion: a dull, persistent throb, weary and seeking a bit of relief
notes: Can precede or follow a body part: 'đau bụng' or 'bụng đau' (to have a stomachache / the stomach hurts).
Also used as an adjective meaning 'sore' or 'painful' (e.g., 'vết thương rất đau' — the wound is very painful).

senses.definition: To feel physical pain or soreness in the body or a part of it.

examples.text: Hôm nay chân tôi rất đau.
examples.translation: My leg hurts a lot today.

senses.definition: To feel deep sadness or emotional pain.

examples.text: Tôi rất đau khi nghe tin đó.
examples.translation: It really hurt when I heard that news.
